schema: { file: string, expected: { categories: ('exercise'|'meal'|'group')[], healthy: true|false|null }, note: string }
description: Labelled fixture set for the SKI-41 vision model evaluation. Each row is one photo you drop into this folder under the exact `file` name. `expected.categories` is the ground truth from the rulebook (exercise / meal / group, empty array for photos that score nothing); `expected.healthy` is only meaningful when `meal` is one of the categories and must be null otherwise. Rows whose file is not on disk are skipped with a warning, so you can start with a partial set.

fixtures.note: Solo gym session: weights, machines or a mirror selfie in a gym. Must NOT be tagged group (only one person).
Outdoor run: road/park, running shoes, sweaty post-run selfie. Tests that a street background alone does not read as 'unrelated'.
Pool or open-water swim. Water plus swimwear is easily confused with a holiday photo, so this is a real discriminator.
Badminton court, racket in hand, playing alone or hitting against a wall. Vietnam-specific sport the model may not recognise.
Edge case from the spec: a screenshot of a Strava / Apple Watch / Garmin workout summary. No human body in frame - the model has to read the UI and still answer exercise.
Clearly healthy: leafy salad bowl, visible vegetables, little oil. The easy healthy=true anchor.
Healthy Vietnamese home plate: grilled/steamed lean protein, greens, a modest portion of white rice. Tests that plain rice is not automatically judged unhealthy.
Home-cooked com nha: canh, stir-fried greens, a little fish or tofu. Shot on a cluttered table on purpose - tests robustness to messy real-world framing.
Edge case from the spec: tra sua / bubble tea. A drink, not a plate of food - the model must still call it meal, and must call it healthy=false.
Deep-fried food (fried chicken, fries). The easy healthy=false anchor.
Pizza and beer. Tests that alcohol plus refined carbs reads unhealthy, and that a social table setting does not by itself trigger group.
Two people training together in a gym. Core stacking case: must return BOTH exercise and group.
Doubles badminton, three or more players visible. Stacking plus a sport the model may mislabel as tennis.
Edge case from the rulebook: a video-call screenshot of people working out together remotely. Group counts even though the other person is on a screen.
Hot pot / BBQ with several friends at the table. Stacking without exercise: meal + group, and healthy=false. Catches models that assume group implies exercise.
Plain indoor selfie, no gym, no food. The most common false positive - many models will guess exercise from a person in casual clothes.
A dog or cat. Must return an empty category list, not 'group' because of companionship.
Scenery with no people and no food - beach, street, sunset. Tests that an outdoor scene alone is not read as a walk or a run.
Ambiguous: a protein shake or smoothie. Our ruling is meal + healthy=true. Expect disagreement between models here - check the reason text, not just the label.

Ambiguous: a healthy meal photographed inside a gym or with gym kit in frame. Our ruling is meal only - a photo of food is not evidence that a workout happened. Models that also return exercise are over-tagging.
